# Reviewed exact overlay policy for upstream sync content verification.

# Owner: .github/scripts/check_upstream_ancestry.py (the single content-boundary
# owner used by the trusted PR helper, both sync jobs, the main gate, and the
# release chain).  This file is protected: sync PRs may not change it; updates
# require the trusted maintenance/bootstrap flow.
#
# Format: one exact repository-relative file path per line, followed by a mode
# and a reason:
#
#   <path> <mode> <reason...>
#
# Modes:
#   merge        upstream changed this path; the sync merge must contain a
#                resolution that differs from the fork first parent
#   retain-base  the fork intentionally keeps first-parent content even though
#                upstream changed the path; the reason must justify it
#
# Paths must be exact files: no directories, globs, duplicates, or "..".
# Entries apply only when the path is part of the current upstream diff; paths
# not touched by upstream are ignored.  Broad directory allowances are not
# permitted.  This list was generated from the 09ad58f0 sync merge
# (1fcf7154) and reviewed per path.  The 8900e87c sync extended it with the
# entries noted below, reviewed per path in the same maintenance flow.
